selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific model type (e.g., M4/AR-15) and ensure it falls within the 'assault rifle' taxonomy rather than a hunting rifle or submachine gun.
To check for edge bleeding between the complex mechanical parts (trigger guard, mag well) and the background, ensuring clean segmentation.
To verify that the mounted scope sits physically on top of the receiver and doesn't float or merge incorrectly with the rail.
To analyze the gibberish text in the bottom right corner to determine if it's a known artifact pattern or random noise.
